description: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account. Users can list and search dashboards, see how a dashboard is set up and which sources feed it, inspect current widget values for supported reporting periods, compare results with another period, identify dashboards with source errors, and turn dashboard results into client-ready summaries. The connector cannot create, edit, delete, send, or schedule anything in the user's DashThis account. It only reads data already available through the user's DashThis dashboards and requires the user to connect their DashThis account with OAuth.
